findings.where: DECISION-PACKETS/F-inventory-decisions.md §5 preamble (inventory L379): "no BINDING-DESIGN entry here has a later non-CONTESTED `Record` heading for the same artifact except D-038"
findings.claim: The claim is false: at least two BINDING-DESIGN entries name an artifact that has a later non-CONTESTED `## D-NNN — Record <artifact>.vN` heading, so under the inventory's own currency rule the versions in those §5 titles (gate-harness-naming.v3 at D-086; component-manifest-schemas.v2 at D-013) are superseded, not current.
